production.note: US model year 2015 only. The F-Type R is split by year range because the car changed twice: rear-wheel drive and 550 hp for 2015, all-wheel drive and 550 hp for 2016 to 2020, all-wheel drive and 575 hp for 2021 to 2024. This record is the rear-drive launch car: '2015 Jaguar F-Type Coupe Preview'; 'the top coupe is called, appropriately, the F-Type R'. For 2016, 'all V8 F-Types will come standard with AWD, including the V8 R Coupe' (autoguide-f-type-awd-2014).

body.note: Coupe only for 2015; the R Convertible arrived for 2016 ('The V8 S Roadster is now dead, replaced by a V8 R Roadster', autoguide-f-type-awd-2014).

displacementL.note: 5,000 cc (engine capacity 5000 cc in the technical table)

drivetrain.note: Motor Authority on the 2015 coupe: 'to emphasize the F-Type Coupe's rear-drive nature'. Jaguar's launch release describes the range 'driving the rear wheels through ZF eight-speed Quickshift transmissions' (jaguar-us-f-type-coupe-unveiled-2013), and the 2015 brochure lists an 'Electronic Active Differential' for the F-TYPE R. Cars.com lists the 2015 V8 R as 'Rear Wheel Drive' (cars-com-2015-f-type-r). All-wheel drive became standard on the R for 2016 (autoguide-f-type-awd-2014).

transmission.note: 'QuickShift 8-speed automatic transmission' (ZF torque-converter automatic). No manual on the V8.

powerHp.note: Quote: "550@6500" in the 'Power (hp@rpm)' row for the F-TYPE R Coupe. The 2015 US brochure: '550 HP' (jaguar-us-f-type-brochure-2015).

weightLb.note: PROVISIONAL, from databases. 2015 F-Type R Coupe, rear-wheel drive, 8-speed automatic (the only configuration). Cars.com: 'Base Curb Weight' 3,638 lbs ('2015 Jaguar F-TYPE V8 R specs & colors'). Edmunds, R 2dr Coupe (5.0L 8cyl S/C 8A): "Curb weight: 3,638 lbs." (edmunds-2015-f-type). Motor Authority (Nelson Ireson) reported Jaguar's claim: "The F-Type R claims an identical curb weight to the F-Type V8 S convertible, at 3,671 pounds." (0.9% higher; see discrepancies).

discrepancies.reason: Unknown; 0.9% apart. 3,638 lb is the Cars.com and Edmunds database figure; 3,671 lb is Jaguar's pre-launch claim as reported by Motor Authority.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,638 lb, where two sources agree; the difference is within the 2% the provisional rules allow.

provisionalNote: Weight is provisional: 3,638 lb rests on Cars.com and Edmunds (databases); Motor Authority reported Jaguar's claim of 3,671 lb. Jaguar's 2015MY technical specification (a zip on media.jlr.com that could not be opened) or a major magazine's spec panel would replace it.
